title: [Decision] A claimed card follows through to MERGED; cross-lane surfaces import the review instead of exporting the card; in-scope derived work and unclaimed blockers stay with the claiming seat (maintainer question after #17718, 2026-09-13)
body:
Filed by the `domain:skills` seat (session `session_01DAcomhvR9kKizeYgg89Vo8`, GitHub `os-project-manager`) at 2026-09-13T07:17Z, as the carrier for a ruling the maintainer asked for live in this seat's chat (2026-09-13T06:5xZ–07:1xZ). ⛔ Not dispatched: the charter change lands in this lane once ruled (`SKILL.md` 〈多仓协调〉/〈认领〉/〈状态模型〉, `references/core-rules.md`, `references/contract-review.md`, `references/dispatch-runbook.md`, `references/state-machine.md`; governed, maintainer hand-merge).

## The maintainer's words (verbatim, untranslated)

> 各车道目前划分是不是太严格,17718 开发了一半换车道,压了好几天。
> 是不是已经立了卡片开始处理的,就应该跟进到底?或者有没有更好的方案?
> 已经立了卡片开始处理的,就应该跟进到底的话,那衍生出来的相关子任务,或者被 blocked 的任务是否也应该作为子任务合并处理,尤其是对于优先级高的卡片。

Per-card precedent already given on #17178 (2026-09-13T06:5xZ, quoted on comment 5651809638): 「17718 你直接跟进到合并。如果需要契约复审你可以派 fable」.

## Governing text

- `SKILL.md` 〈多仓协调〉: 「凡触 `packages/spec` 一律转 `domain:spec` 座位,不论谁需要它。」 · 「跨座位转移:工作跨座位线,PM 永不跨(唯一豁免:简单阻塞项直接接手)。」
- `SKILL.md` 〈状态模型〉 `pm:retriage` row: 「向分诊提问(改判、跨域 PR 指定车道、改路由、拆卡、裁 dev 报告留下的分叉)」; 〈域车道〉: 「跨域例外路径:拆不动的跨域单 PR 由分诊席指定一个车道 PM 认领,认领评论申报文件面。」
- `references/contract-review.md` 〈复核归属与资格〉: 「spec 席审低档实现者的契约增量,非自身产物;余席条款②复核 = 默认判断档自审加门禁。」 · 「独立性件,spec 席:契约判断真分叉或 dev 挂旗 ⇒ 起上下文隔离的达档复核子代理。」
- `references/dispatch-runbook.md` 〈跨车道简单阻塞项直接接手〉: 「只覆盖等一周与做十分钟的形状。」 · 「`packages/spec` 恒归 spec 座位,本条不豁免:唯一所有者规则更硬。」
- `references/state-machine.md`: 「释放者 = 让卡离手的席位:行首 `Release:`(会话/因/去向)与清 assignee 同笔;下一任重新认领。」
- `SKILL.md` 〈Epic 子树车道〉: 「衍生问题三分,判据:不修它 epic 验收过不过得去;in-scope ⇒ 挂父单 sub-issue 下轮自动入队。」 (the subtree model already exists for epics).

Prior rulings read: 「凡触 packages/spec」 · 「跨座位转移」 · 「简单阻塞项」 · 「Release:」 → the five texts above; no ADR governs PM lane ownership; `none` in `docs/adr/**` for `pm:retriage` (control: `ADR-0087` hits 1 file there).

## Measured instance — #17178 / PR #17718 (all stamps from the card and PR)

| UTC | event | wait |
|:--|:--|:--|
| 2026-09-11T18:08Z | dev delivers PR #17718, green (32 success / 6 skipped / 0 failures) | — |
| 2026-09-11T18:11Z | cli seat: 4 of 8 files in `packages/spec` ⇒ `pm:retriage` | |
| 2026-09-13T01:57Z | triage answers: `domain:cli` → `domain:spec`, assignee left (「分诊不重指派」) | **~32 h** (single triage seat; vacant ~20 h; ~23 retriage backlog) |
| 2026-09-13T06:32Z | cli seat releases (`pm:queue`, assignee cleared) | **4 h 35 m** structurally invisible (#17932) |
| 2026-09-13T06:58Z | maintainer direct dispatch: cli seat drives it to merge, contract review by a `fable` agent | total **~37 h** idle for a green PR |

Same family this week: #17849 (spec half of #17323) has carried no `domain:*` since 2026-09-12T12:41Z (three triage windows); #17905 measured a 9-hour knock loss on a cross-lane review request. In this lane today, three cards (#17374 second half, #17569 rider, #17798) wait on devx PR #17803, itself awaiting the maintainer's hand merge.

## Question 1 — who finishes a card that was dispatched into a surface another lane owns

- **A (recommended)** — **认领即跟到底**: the claiming seat owns the card to MERGED. A cross-lane surface discovered after dispatch (`packages/spec` included) does NOT move the card: the seat **imports the review** — an isolated contract-review-tier reviewer subagent (the #17718 precedent), record carrying `Implemented-by:` / `Reviewed-by:` so a self-review is machine-visible; governed paths still park at the human terminal. `pm:retriage` re-routing applies to **undispatched** cards only. The spec seat remains the sole intake for NEW `packages/spec` work (triage routing unchanged). Charter cost: two or three lines across `SKILL.md`, `core-rules.md`, `contract-review.md`, `dispatch-runbook.md`, paid by density.
- **B** — keep the transfer, fix only the mechanics: the patrol row from #17932 (assignee lane ≠ `domain:*`) and 「分诊不重指派」 narrowed to 「分诊不指派给新人」 so a re-route clears the assignee. Saves the 4.5 h; does not save the 32 h.

## Question 2 — derived work and blockers of a card being followed through

| class | test | disposition (recommended) |
|:--|:--|:--|
| in-scope derived work | the card's acceptance cannot pass without it (三分判据 first class) | **folds in**: a sub-issue under the parent; the claiming seat owns the subtree automatically (no return to the pool); priority inherits from the parent; driven to MERGED by the same seat — the epic model generalised to any dispatched card |
| blocker (`Blocked-by:` target) | unclaimed vs already in flight | unclaimed ⇒ the blocked seat **claims and does it**, any size (the S-level cap of 「简单阻塞项」 lifted), contract surfaces by A's imported review; in flight elsewhere ⇒ wait, `pm:blocking` ranks it first in that lane, the waiter is written on the blocker card; p0/p1 parents propagate priority down the chain |
| incidental finding | unrelated to acceptance | **does not fold**: an independent card back to the pool (scope creep otherwise) |

Two boundaries either way: one card = one PR (queue and review granularity kept; a trunk branch per AGENTS.md is the multi-card form); the spec seat keeps the intake of new `packages/spec` work.

## 维护者速读

**改了什么** —— 什么都还没改;这是请你定一条 PM 规则:一张已经派出去、开始做的卡,谁负责把它做完。

**为什么改** —— #17718 交付后因为「碰到了 spec 面就得换席」,一张全绿的 PR 空转了 37 小时:32 小时等分诊席答复改路由(单人席位、空缺近 20 小时),再 4.5 小时因为 assignee 没清而对接收席不可见,最后靠你当面直派才动。同一周还有 #17849(18 小时无人路由)、#17905(9 小时敲门丢失)是同一类交接损耗。车道买的两件事——并行写、契约复审档位——在交付之后都可以在席内满足,不需要把卡交出去。

**风险与代价(含回滚)** —— A 只改章程两三行,不加标签不加状态;复审仍达档、队列守卫与双载体照旧,去掉的只是「静默失败的那一次交接」。风险在 spec 席的独占感:它仍独占新工作的入口,不再收回已交付的活。回滚 = 把那几行改回来。B 只修机械面,便宜但省不下大头。

**席位意见** —— 荐 **A**,并按上面的三类表处理衍生与阻塞项(in-scope 并入子树、无人认领的阻塞项直接做、顺带发现不并)。

**你要做的(一个动作)** —— 回一个字母:**A / B**;若同意三类表,回「同意」即可(不同意的类点名)。

os-decision-facets
- ① 项目长远合理性:A 让「归属在派发时定、不在交付后重议」成为规则,减少交接点(每个交接点都是最慢席位的串行点);B 保留交接、只修可见性。A 收缩特例,不增生契约。
- ② 实际业务拉动:实测三例(#17718 37 h、#17849 18 h+ 无路由、#17905 9 h),全部是交接损耗而非工程状态;本车道另有三张卡等同一张受管 PR 手合。零拉动不成立。
- ③ 防 AI 犯错:A 的复审仍在契约复审档位,记录带 Implemented-by / Reviewed-by,自审机读为 SELF-REVIEW,受管面照旧留 draft;失败方向从「静默不可见」变为「响亮的复核记录缺失」。B 的巡查行也响亮,但只盖住 4.5 小时那一段。
- ④ 创业阶段不扩散:A 不加标签、不加状态、不加工具,改两三行章程;子树归属推广的是既有 epic 模型,不是新机制。
- 推荐:**A**;子树三类表按推荐。回退:B。置信缺口:本分析未量化「交付后换席」在全舰队的频率,只有本周三例;spec 席对 A 的异议未征询(它今天没有在任会话可问)。
